Hi, I am Monika Vurla (Technical Recruiter) always look for potential candidates like you. Below is the requirement with our direct client. Let me know if you interested and available for the job.

 Location:  Troy, OH 45373, USA 
 Duration is approx.: Long term CTH 
 Shift Availability: 2nd shift : 3:00pm - 11:00pm                                       
 3rd shift: 11:00pm - 7:00am 
 Pay rate: $11/hr ( for normal working 8 hrs. ) (overtime $16.50/hr) 

 Job Description: 
 • Assembly OR Break Parts 
 • Following general safety guide lines 
 • Bend stoop and kneel • Keep pace of production line 
 • Wear appropriate PPE 
 • Assembles smaller components onto larger components. 
 • Inspects parts for quality.

 • Conducts machine operation and safety checks on prescribed intervals. 
 • Performs general clean-up and organisation of work area (SCORE- Safety, Cleanliness, Organisation, Responsiveness, and Efficiency). 
 • Other duties as assigned to maintain production.
